soc_pillars.label: Coverage to Relevance
soc_pillars.title: Deep detection over broad coverage
soc_pillars.body: 100% ATT&CK matrix coverage is a vanity metric. What matters is deep, validated detection on the 15-20 techniques your actual adversaries use.

soc_pillars.label: Identity-First Detection
soc_pillars.title: Monitor before attackers touch your systems
soc_pillars.body: Infostealer logs, stolen session cookies, and dark-web credential monitoring are becoming primary detection vectors before attackers ever touch the environment.

soc_pillars.label: Continuous Validation
soc_pillars.title: Weekly automated checks, not quarterly audits
soc_pillars.body: Purple teaming and breach-and-attack simulation are moving from quarterly exercises to weekly automated checks.

soc_pillars.label: Finished Intelligence
soc_pillars.title: TTPs over raw IOC feeds
soc_pillars.body: Raw IOC feeds generate noise. TTP-mapped, finished intelligence drives focused, actionable investigations that cut through alert fatigue.
